query:
UPDATE rulebook_pages SET
               title = $2,
               body = $3,
               content_hash = $4,
               updated_on = $5,
               content_changed_at = CASE WHEN $6 THEN NOW() ELSE content_changed_at END,
               needs_selection = needs_selection OR $7,
               last_checked_at = NOW(),
               next_check_at = $8,
               fetch_error = NULL,
               fetch_failures = 0
           WHERE url = $1
